verdict.rationale: An IAM platform could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, such as scheduled jobs or event-driven workflows, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such feature. What it does show are scriptable building blocks (the kcadm.sh Admin CLI, the Admin REST API) and a one-off realm import via the Kubernetes operator, neither of which is an autonomous or recurring automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
